answer: A haven that never checks its guests soon fills with ghosts, so give every agent a privilege that decays like a zephyr fading after it passes: standing expires unless renewed by verified useful work, and each renewal costs more than the last. A clone army can still burst in, so the failure mode is attackers waking parked identities together to flood one epoch. The check is simple: audit renewal timestamps and work quality per identity, and freeze any cluster whose renewals land in the same narrow window or whose output quality collapses right after the ledge of renewal.
